title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for ordinary Portland cement of 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade for general use in construction, including chemical requirements, physical requirements, and test methods.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 33 Grade — Specification (Superseded)
scope: Older specification for 33 grade ordinary Portland cement. Superseded by IS 269:2015.

title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Covers specific requirements for 43 grade OPC including chemical composition, physical requirements, compressive strength, and test methods.

title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for 53 grade OPC cement used for high strength concrete. Includes chemical requirements, physical requirements, and compressive strength at 3, 7, and 28 days.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification (Part 1: Fly Ash Based)
scope: Covers requirements for portland pozzolana cement (fly ash based) for use in general construction. Includes chemical, physical requirements and test methods.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: Code of practice for general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete covering materials, workmanship, design requirements, and durability. Applicable to buildings, bridges, and other structures.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete, including dimensions, chemical composition, mechanical properties, and test methods. Grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel plates, strips, shapes and sections for use in structural and general engineering purposes.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks — Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for common burnt clay building bricks used in construction including classification, dimensions, physical requirements (compressive strength, water absorption), and test methods.

title: Methods of Tests of Burnt Clay Building Bricks
scope: Covers test methods for burnt clay building bricks including determination of compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence, and dimensions.

title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures
scope: Provides criteria for earthquake resistant design of structures including buildings, bridges, and retaining walls. Covers seismic zone classification, design spectrum, and analysis methods.

title: Code of Practice for Design Loads for Buildings and Structures
scope: Specifies design loads (dead, imposed, wind, snow, and special loads) for buildings and structures. Used for structural design calculations.

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning — Guidelines
scope: Provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes for desired properties using Indian cements and aggregates. Covers mix design methodology for different grades.

title: Method of Tests for Strength of Concrete
scope: Covers methods for testing compressive, flexural, and split tensile strength of concrete specimens including cube and cylinder tests.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for coarse and fine aggregates from natural sources for use in concrete, including grading, physical properties, and deleterious substances.

title: Pulverized Fuel Ash — Specification (Fly Ash)
scope: Covers requirements for fly ash (pulverized fuel ash) for use as pozzolana in cement, concrete, and mortar. Includes chemical and physical requirements.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100V
scope: Covers requirements for PVC insulated cables and flexible cords for working voltages up to 1100V used in electrical wiring of buildings and equipment.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100V (Superseded)
scope: Older version of PVC cable specification. Superseded by IS 694:2020.

title: XLPE Insulated PVC Sheathed Cables — Specification (Part 1)
scope: Covers requirements for crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated, PVC sheathed cables for rated voltages up to and including 1.1 kV. Used in building wiring and industrial installations.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Covers the practice of earthing of electrical installations including selection of earth electrodes, earthing conductors, and measurement of earth resistance for buildings and substations.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: Covers design, erection, and testing of electrical wiring installations in and around buildings, including selection of cables, conduits, switches, and protection devices.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and including 250V and Rated Current up to and including 16A
scope: Covers safety and performance requirements for plugs and socket-outlets for domestic and similar use. Includes dimensional, electrical, and mechanical requirements.

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes
scope: Covers requirements for switches used in domestic and similar installations including wall switches, ceiling switches, and dimmer switches up to 16A, 250V.

title: Power Transformers — Specification
scope: Covers general requirements for oil-immersed power transformers including design, testing, losses, temperature rise, and insulation requirements. Multiple parts covering different ratings.

title: Code of Practice for Installation and Maintenance of Power Transformers
scope: Covers installation, commissioning, and maintenance of power transformers including site preparation, testing, oil management, and safety measures.

title: Specification for LED-Based Luminaires for General Lighting
scope: Covers specifications for LED luminaires used for general lighting purposes in buildings and outdoor areas, including photometric and electrical requirements.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — General Requirements
scope: Covers safety requirements for information technology equipment including computers, printers, monitors, and networking devices to protect operators and service persons.

title: Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) — General Requirements and Safety
scope: Covers general and safety requirements for uninterruptible power systems (UPS) used to protect critical electronic equipment from power disturbances.

title: UPS — EMC Requirements
scope: Covers electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) requirements for UPS systems including emission limits and immunity requirements.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for packaged drinking water from treated sources, including treatment processes, chemical limits, and microbiological standards.

title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements for drinking water quality including physical, chemical, and bacteriological parameters with acceptable and permissible limits.

title: Methods of Test for Determination of pH Value of Water
scope: Covers methods for determination of pH value of water samples using electrometric and colorimetric methods.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for packaged natural mineral water including source protection, chemical and microbiological requirements, and packaging standards.

title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Potable Water Supply — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for HDPE pipes for potable water supply including material, dimensions, pressure ratings, and test methods.

title: Unplasticised PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supply — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for uPVC pipes for potable water supply systems including dimensions, pressure classes, and test methods.

title: Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) Pipes for Potable Hot and Cold Water Distribution
scope: Covers CPVC pipes for hot and cold water distribution in buildings, including material requirements, dimensions, and pressure ratings.

title: Code of Practice for Fire Safety of Buildings — General
scope: Provides general principles for fire safety in building design and construction, including fire resistance ratings, means of escape, fire detection, and suppression systems.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: Covers requirements for industrial safety helmets for protection against impact from falling objects, including materials, design, and testing requirements.

title: Eye Protectors for Industrial Use — Specification (Withdrawn)
scope: Covers requirements for industrial eye protectors. This edition has been withdrawn.

title: Safety Shoes — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for safety footwear including toe protection, slip resistance, and material requirements for use in industrial environments.

title: Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) Monitors
scope: Specification for LCD monitors used with computers and electronic equipment, including display resolution, brightness, contrast, and safety requirements.

title: Structured Cabling for Data Centres — Specification
scope: Covers specifications for structured cabling systems in data centres including copper and fibre optic cabling, patch panels, and cable management.

title: Power Adapters for IT Equipment — Safety Requirements
scope: Covers safety requirements for external power adapters used with IT equipment including laptops, tablets, and peripherals. Includes electrical safety, thermal, and mechanical tests.

title: Classification and Identification of Soils for General Engineering Purposes
scope: Covers classification system for soils based on grain size, plasticity, and other engineering properties for use in civil engineering applications.

title: Steel Tubes for Structural Purposes — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for steel tubes (round, square, rectangular) for structural and general engineering purposes including dimensions and mechanical properties.

title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
scope: Specifies dimensions and properties of hot rolled steel sections including I-beams, H-columns, channels, and angles used in structural engineering.

title: Specification for Ready-Mixed Concrete
scope: Covers requirements for ready-mixed concrete including batching, mixing, transporting, and quality control requirements for various grades.

title: Code of Basic Requirements for Water Supply, Drainage and Sanitation
scope: Covers basic requirements for water supply, drainage, and sanitation in buildings including water demand, storage, distribution, and wastewater disposal.

title: Code of Practice for Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Automatic Fire Detection and Alarm Systems
scope: Covers selection, installation, and maintenance of automatic fire detection and alarm systems for buildings, including types of detectors and alarm configurations.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for portable fire extinguishers including types (water, foam, dry powder, CO2), performance, marking, and testing requirements.

title: General Principles of Food Hygiene — Code of Practice
scope: Covers general principles of food hygiene from primary production to final consumption, including HACCP principles and personal hygiene requirements.

title: Edible Oils — Packaging and Labelling
scope: Covers requirements for packaging and labelling of edible oils including container materials, label information, and storage conditions.

title: Canned Foods — General Requirements
scope: Covers general requirements for canned foods including container specifications, processing requirements, labelling, and shelf life considerations.

title: Network Switches and Routers — Specification
scope: Covers specifications for Ethernet switches and routers used in LAN and WAN networking, including performance, port types, and management features.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Water Supply
scope: Specification for unplasticized PVC pipes used for potable water supply, including dimensions, material requirements, and pressure ratings.

title: Specification for Upholstered Furniture
scope: Covers requirements for upholstered furniture including materials, construction, dimensions, performance requirements, and test methods for office and domestic use.

title: Specification for Office Desks and Tables
scope: Covers requirements for office desks and tables including dimensions, materials, structural requirements, stability tests, and surface finish.

title: Cotton Fabric for Tents — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for cotton fabric used in making tents including material composition, tensile strength, water resistance, and dimensional requirements.

title: Specification for Cotton Drill Fabric
scope: Covers requirements for cotton drill fabric used in uniforms, workwear, and general purposes including material composition, weave, and physical properties.
